description: SetErrorType has both a hand-rolled Display impl (23-arm match mapping to camelCase strings) and #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")] on the enum. These can diverge: add a new variant, update serde via the derive, forget to update Display (or vice versa). Display is used in error messages; serde is used on the wire. Today they agree, but there's no compile-time enforcement. Fix: remove Display impl entirely and use serde serialization where a string representation is needed (serde_json::to_value(self).ok().and_then(|v| v.as_str().map(str::to_owned))), or use the strum crate's AsRefStr derive.
title: SetErrorType::Display hand-rolled match can drift from serde output
